column1: # FAST Fusion (Switch 2, v262144). Plays on the Mac: see README.md
# Shin'en Multimedia's own engine, SDK 20.5.13 built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), NVN2. Modules main, sdk; subsdk0 and subsdk1 (C / libc) are not loaded.
# The shaders are stage records in Shin'en's SHN! resource files (.shdr shader sets, .w3d models): shader_split.py shn_shaders.
# Made by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py from the survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py); the values below are its guesses, kept as the game runs with them.
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (C / libc), subsdk1 (C / libc)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 9216 MB heap region
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (spec: Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 (regress.py: "profile depth_mode gl disagrees with runtime depth_mode zero"): the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
